journal_copy.cross_check: the by-id count against `-u <unit>`; a unit NAME names every run ever launched under it, an id names ONE
journal_copy.field_not_used_here: INVOCATION_ID -- the SYSTEM manager's field; it matches nothing under --user
fields_matched: USER_INVOCATION_ID (the user manager's lines: Started, Consumed, Failed)
journal_copy.how_that_is_computed: da_root.journal_coverage: the host journal's oldest retained entry against the unit's own start timestamp -- TWO MEASURED CLOCKS, no needle. The old predicate searched the copied lines for ' Started ' and reported TRUE on a tail that had lost 141 of 161 lines
journal_copy.output_format_note: journalctl -o short-iso-precise: an ISO timestamp, the host and the process prefix, then the message. A copy that does not name its format cannot be diffed against one that used another

retention.it_is_a_MEASUREMENT_not_a_property: five reads across one hour walked the window's start from 08:45Z to 09:29:57Z -- about as fast as the clock. A retention state named once is stale within minutes, so it carries its own as-of and query (R-646 R4)
retention.oldest_entry_from: the entry's OWN clock, as journald printed it -- never typed, never a policy setting
retention.query: journalctl --user --no-pager -o short-iso-precise (first line = the oldest entry retained)

my_own_poll.note: five fields + id at every sample, ≤5 min apart

reason: R-659: stopped by the coordinator before emit -- design v22's seal scope superseded by v23. The run was emitting under v22, which leaves three OUTCOME counts open (n_fills_arm, n_fills_baseline, n_cancels_issued) that v23 SEALS; a receipt emitted under v22 would carry them open

the_five_fields_and_the_id_copied_BEFORE.why_before: after `systemctl stop` the unit is stopped and after collection every field is a DEFAULT; the reading has to be taken while it is loaded and running

this_is_a_stop_before_emit_not_a_re_roll.why_that_is_not_a_re_roll: a re-roll discards a RESULT and runs again. No result existed: the run had not reached its emit and no artifact under the sealed layout was written
